title: Xertuncraft
description: Whitelisted semi-vanilla tomfoolery, with land claims.
body:
Whitelisted Fabric Minecraft server running on 1.21.11. 

## Rules
1. Cheating. No mods that provide an unfair advantage.
2. Language. Swearing is fine, but be mindful of your fellow player.
3. Semi-Anarchy. We have land claims ([Flan](https://wiki.blazing-coop.net/flan/Flan)), but everything else is fair game.
4. Fair Play. Don't try to ruin the game (e.g. lag machines). 

## Gameplay
- Worldgen: Tectonic & Terralith (along with various structure mods) make the overworld much more interesting, and Incendium overhauls the nether.
- Mechanics: Leashable villagers, buffed bows/crossbows/maces/tridents, no more "Too Expensive," various extra enchantments, and uncapped minecart speed.
- Difficulty: Mobs are smarter and hit harder.

Join the Discord and ask in #minecraft-server to be whitelisted.
